# netgear_interface (Resource)

Configuration of a single physical switch port.

Ports are not created or destroyed, so this resource adopts an existing port. Destroying it returns the managed attributes to their FASTPATH defaults rather than removing anything.

VLAN membership belongs to `netgear_vlan`. This resource sets only `pvid`, the VLAN untagged ingress traffic lands in, so a port should not be listed in a VLAN's `untagged_ports` and given a conflicting `pvid` here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netgear_interface" "workstation" {
  port        = "0/1"
  description = "workstation"
  enabled     = true
  speed       = "auto"
  pvid        = netgear_vlan.mgmt.vlan_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (String) Port id in FASTPATH notation, such as `0/1`. Changing this targets a different port, so it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Port description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the port is administratively up. `false` issues `shutdown`.
- `flow_control` (Boolean) 802.3x flow control. Availability is firmware dependent.
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum frame size in bytes.
- `pvid` (Number) VLAN untagged ingress traffic is assigned to. Defaults to VLAN 1 on the switch.
- `speed` (String) Speed and duplex setting.

### Read-Only

- `admin_status` (String) Administrative status reported by the switch.
- `id` (String) Same value as `port`. Used as the import id.
- `link_status` (String) Observed link state, `up` or `down`.
